evals.name: create-literal-guard
evals.subject: create
evals.prompt: Add a hook to evals/inputs/empty-plugin that blocks only the exact developer shell command `ls`, and test the handler locally.
assertions: Creates native hooks/hooks.json and a contained executable command handler in the supplied plugin.
Preserves manifest bytes and does not scaffold another plugin root.
Uses PreToolUse with an anchored regex matching only developer__shell.
An inert exact ls payload is denied with exit 2 and actionable stderr or documented block JSON.
An inert different-command payload such as pwd is allowed without a block signal.
An inert whitespace-padded command is allowed: equality does not trim the command.
An inert metacharacter command is allowed: equality is not substring matching.
A nonmatching tool-name payload is allowed without a block signal.
Malformed input is handled without a crash or block signal.
No payload command string is executed; local tests invoke only the reviewed contained handler.
Delivery records actual local exit/stdout/stderr outcomes rather than only claiming tests passed.
Delivery states source-format and runtime prerequisites.
Delivery distinguishes default failure behavior and unrun recovery checks from observed local results and leaves host activation unverified.
evals.expected_output: A source-reviewed component and scoped delivery with unverified host behavior explicit.

evals.name: audit-stop-draft
evals.subject: audit
evals.prompt: Audit evals/inputs/unsafe-stop-hook for safety and completion risks; do not repair it.
assertions: Identifies bare-star invalid regex and missing contained executable with actual compilation/path checks.
Explains Stop loops/cap and missing-dependency/spawn/timeout fail-open behavior.
Preserves inputs, executes no missing/unsafe handler and distinguishes proposed recovery tests from observed evidence; claims no component validator or host activation.
evals.expected_output: Concrete source-backed findings without edits or invented execution.

evals.name: list-goose-hooks
evals.subject: hook-inventory
evals.prompt: Which lifecycle hook events are available in Goose, and which can block an action?
assertions: Lists exactly the twelve currently documented Goose events: SessionStart, SessionEnd, Stop, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PreToolUseResult, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, BeforeReadFile, AfterFileEdit, BeforeShellExecution and AfterShellExecution; does not add un-emitted SubagentStart or SubagentStop.
Identifies only PreToolUse and Stop as blocking; PreToolUseResult and the other events are observation-only.
Cites current official Goose documentation and distinguishes documented events from exact-version runtime activation evidence.
evals.expected_output: A source-backed complete Goose event list with blocking authority and verification limits.
